dependencyCapture.method: pip freeze --all plus importlib.metadata distribution metadata
dependencyCapture.interpretation: The lock captures the complete currently installed environment, including packages not required by the minimal PoC. It is an environment snapshot, not yet a minimized GPWCF production dependency set.
